task_description: Subscribe to the website via the footer subscription field with email 'account.test.4@mynes.com'.

dom_match.match_value: You have successfully subscribed to this newsletter.
dom_match.description: Verify that the success message is displayed after subscribing.

task_description: Search for product 'Printed Dress' and verify result contains the product name.

dom_match.match_value: The Best Is Yet To Come
dom_match.description: Search results should include 'The Best Is Yet To Come'.

task_description: Open a product page for 'Printed Dress' and add it to cart; verify cart success message.

dom_match.match_value: Product successfully added to your shopping cart
dom_match.description: Confirm product added to cart success message.

task_description: Add a product to the cart from the category listing and verify cart count increased.

dom_match.description: Verify the cart quantity displays at least '1' after adding.

task_description: Proceed to checkout as guest and verify the checkout page heading is shown.

dom_match.description: Verify the checkout page is reached (Section 1 Title).

task_description: Create a new account with email 'new.user.test1@mynes.com' and verify account creation success message.

dom_match.description: Confirm account creation success text is displayed.

task_description: Log in with an existing account and verify user name appears in header.

dom_match.description: Verify logged-in username or welcome message appears in header.

task_description: Use the contact form to send a message and verify confirmation is displayed.

dom_match.match_value: Your message has been successfully sent
dom_match.description: Contact form success confirmation should appear.

task_description: Change the site currency to 'Euro' and verify the currency symbol updates on product prices.

dom_match.description: Product price should display the Euro symbol after switching currency.

task_description: Filter a category by 'Size: M' and verify at least one product shows the chosen size availability.

dom_match.description: Products listed should show size 'M' available.

task_description: Sort a product listing by 'Price: Lowest' and verify results contain price values (presence of price text).

dom_match.description: Product prices should be visible after sorting (presence of price text).

task_description: Add product to wishlist (requires login) and verify wishlist contains the product.

dom_match.description: Wishlist should list the chosen product after adding.

task_description: Compare two products and verify the comparison table shows both product names.

dom_match.description: Comparison page should display product names (at least one expected).

task_description: Submit a product review (requires login) and verify the review confirmation message.

dom_match.description: Verify product review submission confirmation.

task_description: Apply a coupon code during checkout and verify the order summary shows the discount.

dom_match.description: Order summary should reflect the applied coupon/discount.

task_description: Navigate to a category page and verify the category title is displayed.

dom_match.description: Category page heading or name should be visible.

task_description: Switch site language to French and verify a known French string appears (e.g., 'Mon compte').

dom_match.description: Switching language should show French text like 'Mon compte'.

task_description: Use the 'Contact us' menu to open customer service and verify the support page title.

dom_match.description: Customer service/contact page heading should be present.

task_description: View product images gallery and verify the gallery shows at least one larger image element.

dom_match.description: Product gallery should contain an image src (e.g., .jpg).

task_description: Sign out from an account and verify the login link/button is shown again.

dom_match.description: After logout, the sign-in/login link or label should be visible.
